Sender address → project
Recognised senders — our own people
Most invoices are forwarded on by someone here rather than sent by the supplier. Mail from one of our own domains is read as a forward — the supplier is taken from the quoted message behind it and the forwarder is recorded on the invoice. Every other address is treated as a supplier or subcontractor, including a personal address belonging to someone who works here.

Set on the Allocate Unassigned Invoices row of Settings → Roles & permissions. No cost codes yet. Upload a CSV (columns: parent code, parent code description, child code, child code description) or click ＋ Add parent code, then add child codes under it.
From Excel, use File → Save As → “CSV UTF-8 (Comma delimited)” — not the .xlsx workbook. Blank parent cells under a group are filled in automatically.
A parent code is a broad group (e.g. 03 — PRELIMINARIES); each holds one or more child codes (e.g. 03-002 — PRELIMINARIES: SCAFFOLDING). Use ＋ Add child code to add more items to a parent. Child codes feed every project's Budget selector (shown as parent · child — description).
